system.description: Restraints take many different forms, from handcuffs to well-tied ropes, but they all restrict the movements of a prisoner. A character may place restraints on a target with the grappled condition by succeeding at another grapple action against the target and choosing to bind the wrists or ankles (on a humanoid target). Restraints are built tough; add 5 times their TL to their HP. A character in wrist restraints (DC 15 Acrobatics to escape) suffers disadvantage on all arm and hand based actions (including escaping restraints). A character in ankle restraints (DC 20 Acrobatics to escape) has its speed reduced to 1m. A character shackled by both its wrists and legs (DC 24 acrobatics to escape) gains the restrained condition.
